spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.signature_properties
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, (M7.RecipeSignature.signature c).Monic ∧ M7.RecipeSignature.signature c ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
spec.guidance: Literal signature_divides gives divisibility into nonzero monic modulus. Therefore signature is nonzero, and accepted SignatureTau.binary_monic applies. No weight/connectedness/odd-N premise is needed. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.pair_ideal_action
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.SignatureIdeal.pairIdeal N (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Action.act g c).1) (M7.Supports.polynomial (M7.Action.act g c).2) = (M7.SignatureIdeal.pairIdeal N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2)).map (M7.QuotientAuto.substitution g.unit)
spec.guidance: Unfold actual pairIdeal and identify AffinePolynomial.image. Accepted action_images gives both generators as separate rho shift units times substituted original images. Use accepted rho_power_unit and Ideal.span_insert / Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit to remove these units. Ideal.map_span + Set.image_pair give the actual mapped pair; exchange is handled by Ideal.span_pair_comm. Do not assume arbitrary isometry or signature invariance. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.action_signature
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M7.Action.act g c) = M7.SignatureTau.sourceTau g.unit (M7.RecipeSignature.signature c)
spec.guidance: Rewrite source_tau_equal to tau. Apply SignatureIdeal.monic_injective with actual signature_properties and tau_properties. The ideal equality follows from full_signature_ideal on input/output, actual pair_ideal_action and tau_principal. This is the literal full gcd signature including all multiplicities and exchange. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.tau_degree
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) → (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F).natDegree = F.natDegree
spec.guidance: Instantiate accepted QuotientDegree.degree_invariant N F (tau u F) with concrete SignatureTau.equiv u, tau_properties and tau_principal.symm. The RingEquiv.toRingHom is definitionally actual substitution u. Reverse the resulting equality. No new quotient-cardinality proof. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.action_signature_degree
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, (M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M7.Action.act g c)).natDegree = (M7.RecipeSignature.signature c).natDegree
spec.guidance: Rewrite action_signature then source_tau_equal, and use tau_degree with the actual literal signature_properties. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.translation_invariant
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ E : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial → Prop, M7.ActualFactorized.TranslationInvariant (N := N) (M7.RecipeSignature.region (N := N) E)
spec.guidance: Introduce actual c,s,t. action_signature for translate has unit1; source_tau_equal then tau_one with signature_properties proves literal signature unchanged, hence region membership unchanged. This discharges the earlier factorized TranslationInvariant hypothesis for every actual signature query. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.outer_source_signature
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ u : M7.ActualFactorized.Outer N, M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M7.ActualFactorized.outerImage c u) = M7.SignatureTau.sourceTau u.1 (M7.RecipeSignature.signature c)
spec.guidance: Use action_signature on the literal zero-shift record with unit u.1 and exchange u.2; unfold outerImage. This gives the exact source unit-sector expression and shows exchange does not change it. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.sector_meets_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ E : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial → Prop, ((∃ g : M7.Action.Record N, E (M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M7.Action.act g c))) ↔ ∃ u : (ZMod N)ˣ, E (M7.SignatureTau.sourceTau u (M7.RecipeSignature.signature c)))
spec.guidance: Forward choose actual g.unit and rewrite action_signature. Backward construct the actual record ⟨u,false,0,0⟩ and rewrite action_signature (or outer_source_signature); do not assume a sector realizer oracle. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.RecipeSignature.source_orbit_quotient
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ (E : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial → Prop) (L R : Finset (ZMod N) → Prop), M7.RecipeSignature.sourceCount c E L R = M7.ActualOrbit.distinctCount c (fun y => E (M7.RecipeSignature.signature y) ∧ L y.1 ∧ R y.2) ∧ M7.ActualFactorized.stabilizerNumerator c ∣ M7.RecipeSignature.sourceNumerator c E L R
spec.guidance: Instantiate ActualFactorized.exact_orbit_quotient with the actual region E and the proved translation_invariant. Rewrite each outer image signature by outer_source_signature, unfolding region/sourceCount/sourceNumerator. No translation-invariance or free automorphism hypothesis remains in this final source-numerator formula. Keep exact divisibility as well as quotient equality. Return tactic lines without leading by.
